name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport IT began unconventionally, not through racing, but through a lifelong fascination with complex systems. After graduating with a degree in Computer Science, he spent several years in the financial sector, honing his skills in data management and network security. However, the allure of the high-octane world of racing proved too strong, and he took a significant pay cut to join a smaller racing team, eventually finding his place at Kart Academy.

Alistair's approach to IT systems management is deeply pragmatic. He prioritizes reliability and security above all else, understanding that even the smallest glitch can have significant consequences on race day. He is a firm believer in preventative maintenance and thorough testing, ensuring that all systems are running smoothly and efficiently. What sets Alistair apart is his ability to translate complex technical issues into simple, actionable solutions that the rest of the team can understand.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed to the side with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a slightly stooped posture from years of sitting at a computer.

quirks: Always carries a small multi-tool in his pocket, 'just in case'.
Insists on backing up all critical data to physical hard drives, despite the team's cloud storage.
Has a habit of muttering code snippets under his breath when stressed.
